concerns.text: Task T011 bundles multiple distinct analysis activities (regression, ANOVA, theoretical bound validation, sweet‑spot detection, figure generation, methods summary, reproducibility log) into a single checklist item. This makes the task overly coarse for deterministic execution and hampers atomic verification. Split T011 into separate tasks (e.g., T011‑a regression, T011‑b theoretical bound, T011‑c sweet‑spot, T011‑d figures, T011‑e methods summary, T011‑f reproducibility log) each with its own artifact list and verification step.
